Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_CriticalAlwa: Cutting melee criticals always dismember limbs
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropCloth: Drop decorative cloth when long sleeves are destroyed (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropMax: Shared maximum of loaded limbs and cloth (0: disable)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropLife: Lifetime in real seconds (0: no time limit)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropFlight: Vanilla temporary drawing for arm and leg flight (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropPerZombi: Does not limit amputations. One-piece allowance survives saving and loading. Cloth has its own switch.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropBlood: Blood drips during limb flight (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_CrawlBlood: Blood trails from amputated crawling zombies (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BleedTime: Bleeding duration after amputation, real seconds (0: disable)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BleedMarks: Shared maximum blood marks per zombie (0–2048; 0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BloodBudget: Shared extra blood emissions per second (0–256; 0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BloodMaxZomb: Shared maximum blood emitters: zombies and pieces (0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_PoolBlood: Brief pools under living amputees on the ground (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_PoolBlood_to: Dense-core pool under a living stationary amputee on the floor, including armless zombies. Grows with elapsed time and emitted blood onto neighboring loaded floors.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BleedAmount: Maximum marks per zombie blood patch (1–16)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_CrawlBlood_t: Ground-moving amputees bleed during their configured window. Leg wounds use an approximate knee position based on facing and severed side. Duration and allowance persist across saving/loading and are not renewed by further cuts.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropPools: Small blood pools under landed limbs (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropPools_to: Does not affect cloth scraps. Has its own duration and allowance, sharing the global blood budget. Saving/loading does not renew it.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropPoolTime: Piece bleeding, real seconds from landing (0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_DropPoolMark: Maximum blood marks per piece (0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_CutBlood_too: Adds stains and up to three visible drops at the cut. Shares the global blood limit; trails and pools may be disabled. Does not alter the original impact blood.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_CutBloodMark: Extra blood marks on each cut (0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadBurstCou: Visible fragments per head burst (SP only; 0–64; 0: disabled)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadBurst_to: Each shotgun decapitation prioritizes up to six burst particles, respecting a lower configured count. Older extra particles are recycled first; maximum64 active. Extreme saturation replaces the oldest core particles. The visual core may exceed an exhausted extra budget without adding floor blood. Disabled burst, zero count or zero budget disables the core.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadDrops: Whole heads with katana or sword (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadDrops_to: Requires detached pieces enabled. Whole heads only on confirmed sword or katana decapitations; shotgun uses explosion. Shares saved per-zombie allowance, total pieces, lifetime and distance. Cannot be picked up. Combat chances stay unchanged.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_NeckBlood: Brief neck blood splash on decapitation (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_NeckBlood_to: Up to six vanilla droplets for 650 ms from an approximate neck position. Independent of radial burst; shares global budget and 32-particle limit.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BleedAmount_: Remaining allowance is paced over the bleeding window so the initial pool leaves blood for later crawling. This is a maximum per pulse.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadHair: Copy vanilla hairstyle to detached heads (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadBurstSca: Shotgun explosion: blood particle size (SP only)
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadHair_too: Copies the vanilla hairstyle and its original colour as part of the same static head. No beard or hat. Unknown mod hairstyles use a bald head. Enabled when a new head is created; existing heads keep their saved appearance.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadGoreCoun: 0 disables solid chunks. Requires shotgun head explosion and detached-piece flight enabled; does not require whole-piece drops. Up to eight shared active flights and the global piece limit. Chunks vanish on landing and cannot become loot.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadBurstSca: Scales only shotgun explosion blood sprites, from1 to5. Neck spray and ordinary blood retain their original size.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_ImpactBlood_: Controls the initial native floor splash and body stains on amputation or decapitation. Independent of extra cut blood, pools, trails, flight blood and explosions. Disable those effects too to stop all added emissions. Wound textures retain their appearance. Works in SP and MP.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_BloodBudget_: Limits ordinary extra emissions and floor blood. Core burst particles consume available budget, but remain visible when it is exhausted: a transient-only exception within the64-particle cap. Zero disables the core too. Does not replenish pools or persistent bleeding.
Sandbox_ZombieDismemberment_HeadBurstCou: Requested particle count per shotgun decapitation; zero disables particles. The first six, or all particles if fewer, receive priority. Remaining particles require space and budget.3D chunks have their own option.
